NAME: AHB-Lite interconnect verification plan
details: Blocks 6 and 7: ahb_interconnect with its arbiter, decoder, multiplexers and default slave. Four masters, four slave regions, one shared layer. Source: GARUDA-AHB-SPEC-001 and garuda_system.yaml. Feature-level plan written 2026-10-04, before the UVM environment. Sign-off criteria: flow/0_signoff_criteria.md. An arbiter is control logic that formal proves exhaustively, so nearly every feature here is also assigned to formal.

NAME: A Protocol
details: Requirement R-1.

NAME: F01 AHB-Lite compliance on every port
details: Address and control stable while HREADY is low, no retraction, legal HTRANS sequences, legal responses - on all four master ports and on the stream the slaves see.
implementation_note: Method: sim (protocol checker on every port) + formal. Today: ahb_lite_checker on five ports, 0 violations; the checker has its own self-test

NAME: ahb_checker
details: AHB-Lite protocol checker - 0 violations on each of the nine ports.
implementation_note: tb/ahb/ahb_lite_checker.v, bound on five today.

NAME: F02 Signals that are not implemented
details: HPROT is not decoded and is tied at the slaves; HMASTLOCK does not exist; only SINGLE and INCR bursts occur. Spec [N-5.2] to [N-5.4].
implementation_note: Method: sim + review. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T10

NAME: a_hprot_const
details: HPROT at every slave is the documented constant, or the DMA substitution.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned.

NAME: B Arbitration
details: Spec 7.2. Requirement R-5.

NAME: F03 Fixed priority - DMA debug SBA data port instruction port
details: Among the masters requesting at a beat boundary the highest wins. Spec [N-7.3].
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim (four master agents with random requests). Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T4 for three masters together; the three pairs with SBA are not driven together

NAME: a_priority
details: At every beat boundary the granted master is the highest-priority requester.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_arb.cp_request_set
details: All 15 non-empty sets of requesting masters at a beat boundary.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F04 Exactly one master is granted
details: Never two, and never none while any requests.
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim. Today: the grant is an encoded index in the RTL

NAME: a_grant_onehot
details: The grant selects exactly one master in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F05 The grant never moves inside a data phase
details: Once an address phase is accepted the grant is locked until that transfer's data phase ends. The single most important property of the arbiter. Spec [N-7.5].
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T5, T14, T16

NAME: a_grant_stable_in_data_phase
details: The data-phase master does not change while HREADY is low.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_arb.x_wait_preempt
details: A higher master requesting during a data phase of 0, 1, 3 and 15 wait states.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F06 Write data follows the data-phase master
details: HWDATA at the slaves belongs to the master whose transfer is in its data phase, not the one being granted. Erratum AHB-1.
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T14

NAME: a_hwdata_data_phase
details: HWDATA at the slaves equals the data-phase master's HWDATA.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F07 An ungranted master is held and loses nothing
details: It sees HREADY low; its address and control are taken when it is granted. Spec [N-7.20].
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T5

NAME: a_ungranted_held
details: An ungranted requesting master sees HREADY low.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: sb_xfer
details: Every transfer a master issues reaches a slave exactly once, with its own data back.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F08 A burst split by a higher master resumes as NONSEQ
details: The interposed beat completes, then the instruction port's next beat is NONSEQ at the slave. The preempted master keeps its response. Requirement R-9, spec [N-7.6], errata AHB-2 and AHB-3.
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T11, T12, T13, T15

NAME: a_burst_restart_nonseq
details: The first beat a master issues after losing the grant is NONSEQ on the slave side.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_arb.cp_preempt_beat
details: A burst preempted at beat 1, 2, 3 and at the last beat.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F09 Progress of the lowest-priority master
details: Under continuous requests from the others the instruction port waits; it must proceed as soon as there is a gap, and the documented traffic leaves gaps. Spec [N-7.7].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal (bounded). Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T16 with random traffic; no sustained-load test

NAME: cg_arb.cp_m0_wait
details: Instruction port waiting 1, 10, 100 and 1000 beats.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: a_no_deadlock
details: A requesting master is granted within a bounded number of beats once no higher master requests.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: C Decode and reach
details: Spec 7.3, 7.4. Requirements R-3, R-4.

NAME: F10 Address bits 31 -28 select the slave
details: 0 ISRAM, 1 boot ROM, 2 DSRAM, 4 APB, and every other value the default slave. Spec [N-7.11].
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T1, T1b, T3

NAME: a_decode
details: The selected slave is the function of HADDR bits 31:28 in the table.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_dec.cp_nibble
details: All 16 values of HADDR bits 31:28, from each master.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F11 Exactly one select the default slave included
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T2

NAME: a_hsel_onehot
details: Exactly one of the five selects is high in every address phase.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F12 The select follows the transfer into its data phase
details: Read data and response come from the slave addressed in the address phase, for back-to-back transfers to different slaves.
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T6

NAME: a_resp_from_addressed_slave
details: HRDATA, HREADY and HRESP are those of the data-phase slave.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_dec.cp_slave_pair
details: Every ordered pair of slaves in back-to-back transfers.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F13 Every master reaches every slave it is allowed
details: No wire is missing. Requirement R-4, spec [N-7.8], [N-7.9].
implementation_note: Method: formal (connectivity) + sim. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T1, T16, T17 cover some of the 16 pairs

NAME: cg_reach.x_master_slave
details: Each master to each slave it may address, read and write.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: sb_xfer
details: Model compare.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F14 What the DMA may reach
details: The system description and this specification allow the DMA to reach ISRAM; the DMA specification (R-9) and the DMA RTL refuse ISRAM and boot ROM addresses. The three have to be made to agree.
implementation_note: Method: review. Today: tb_dma_top [R-9] checks the refusal

NAME: review
details: garuda_system.yaml ahb.master_reachability against DMA R-9.
implementation_note: To be logged in Docs/BUGS.md.

NAME: D Errors
details: Spec 7.6. Requirement R-6.

NAME: F15 An undecoded address gives a two-cycle ERROR and never a hang
details: From any master, read or write, and the bus is usable in the next cycle. Spec [N-7.16], [N-7.18].
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T3, T3b

NAME: a_error_two_cycle
details: ERROR is HRESP high with HREADY low, then HRESP high with HREADY high.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_no_black_hole
details: Every selected transfer ends within a bounded number of cycles.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_err.x_nibble_master
details: Each of the 12 unused values of HADDR bits 31:28 from each master.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F16 An error goes to the master that caused it and to no other
details: A waiting master does not see another master's ERROR. Spec [N-7.17].
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T9, T9b

NAME: a_error_not_broadcast
details: HRESP is high only at the data-phase master.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F17 A slave error in the middle of a stream
details: The following transfer, already in its address phase, is handled as the protocol allows and the stream continues.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T9

NAME: cg_err.cp_error_then
details: ERROR followed by an idle, by a transfer of the same master, and by a transfer of another master.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: E Wait states and timing
details: Spec 7.7. Requirement R-8.

NAME: F18 The interconnect adds no wait state
details: HREADY at the granted master is the selected slave's, in the same cycle. Spec [N-7.19].
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T8 checks slave waits pass through; nothing counts added waits

NAME: a_no_inserted_wait
details: HREADY at the data-phase master equals the data-phase slave's hreadyout.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F19 Slave wait states of any length
details: From 0 to the bridge's 16-cycle limit, with requests arriving during the wait.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T8, random wait option

NAME: cg_wait.x_slave_waits
details: Each slave with 0, 1, 2 to 8 and more wait states.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F The SBA indication
details: Spec 7.5. Requirement R-7.

NAME: F20 hmaster_is_sba follows the data-phase master
details: High exactly when the transfer in its data phase belongs to the debugger. Spec [N-7.14].
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T17 and a monitor in every cycle

NAME: a_sba_ind
details: The indication equals data-phase master is M2.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_sba.cp_neighbours
details: A debugger write directly before and after a write from each other master.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: G Reset
details: Spec section 9.

NAME: F21 Reset state
details: The instruction port is granted, no slave is selected and HREADY is high, so the first request is accepted at once. Spec [N-9.2].
implementation_note: Method: formal + sim. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect T0

NAME: a_reset_state
details: In the cycle after reset the grant is M0, all selects are 0 and HREADY is 1.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/ahb/ahb_interconnect_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F22 Reset in the middle of a transfer
details: From each master, in the address phase and in a waited data phase.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: no check.

NAME: cg_rst.cp_reset_phase
details: Reset with a transfer in each phase.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: H With the rest of the chip
details: Checked at chip level.

NAME: F23 The four real masters together
details: Core fetching and loading, the DMA transferring and the debugger reading, on the real memories and bridge.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level (scenario). Today: sw/chip tests run two or three at a time; AHB checkers at chip level report 0 violations

NAME: t_chip_dma_traffic
details: Shared with the DMA plan.
implementation_note: sw/chip. Planned.

NAME: t_chip_jtag
details: Debugger and core on the bus together.
implementation_note: Passing.

NAME: F24 A bus error becomes a precise fault in the right master
details: Instruction access fault, load or store access fault, DMA channel error, or sberror. Spec [N-7.17].
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level. Today: sw/tests/t_buserr.S; sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c; tb_dma_top; tb_debug

NAME: t_chip_integ
details: Precise fault part.
implementation_note: Passing.
